name: tart-xcode-runner
description: Run isolated Xcode builds and XCUITests in reusable, resettable Tart macOS VMs.

interface.shortDescription: Reusable macOS VMs for isolated Xcode builds and XCUITests
interface.longDescription: Build Apple-platform projects and run XCUITests away from the host in reusable Tart macOS VMs. Create exact macOS and Xcode images, run work in disposable clones, retrieve logs and xcresult bundles, then reset or roll back safely.
defaultPrompt: Run this XCUITest in a disposable Tart VM and return the xcresult bundle.
Build this Xcode project in a resettable Tart VM.
Run this command in the Tart VM without using the host.
